What is this?

Every YSWS asks you to ship a website.

Almost all of them are built on a laptop. For a laptop.

On a phone: desktop mode, pinch, zoom, tap the wrong link, give up.

Mobile Friendly is the YSWS where your phone is the main screen.

See how it works

6x

faster on a 3G phone when the page is built for it

  • 3GMobile optimized2.5 sHeavy desktop page15 s
  • 4GMobile optimized0.4 sHeavy desktop page1.6 s
  • 5GMobile optimized0.2 sHeavy desktop page0.5 s

Example: a 3 MB desktop-style page vs a 0.5 MB mobile-optimized one, at rough typical speeds. Shorter bar = loads faster.

How this works

Five steps.

  1. 11. Open your site on your phone. Your real phone, not a resized window. Notice every pinch, zoom and sideways scroll.
  2. 22. Find what feels sloppy. Tiny text, buttons a thumb can’t hit, menus that only open on hover.
  3. 33. Fix the layout. Stack the columns, size buttons for thumbs, keep it readable at 360px wide.
  4. 44. Ship it. Post the link and the repo in #mobile-friendly. A reviewer tries it one-handed on a real phone.
  5. 55. Get your phone stuff. Passed? Pick a case, a charger, a power bank or other accessories and we mail it to you.
